description: Retrieve rows matching explicit values or conditions.
Request top or bottom N records, or order records by a measure.
sql_template:
SELECT Title
FROM posts
ORDER BY ViewCount DESC
LIMIT 5;

description: Compare a value with another value, threshold, or condition.
Count records or distinct values that satisfy conditions.
sql_template:
SELECT COUNT(T2.member_id)
FROM zip_code AS T1
INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.zip_code = T2.zip
WHERE T1.state = 'Maryland';

description: Apply a standard aggregate such as sum, average, minimum, or maximum.
sql_template:
SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm)
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

description: Apply a domain rule, specialized threshold, or domain-specific interpretation.
sql_template:
SELECT T1.ID,
       STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HCT > 52
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING COUNT(ID) >= 2
);

description: Perform arithmetic, a ratio, percentage, or another derived formula.
sql_template:
SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Age > 65, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts AS T1
INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id
WHERE T1.Score > 20;

description: Map an alternate term in the question to a stored concept or value.
sql_template:
SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id)
FROM client AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND T2.A2 = 'Jesenik';

description: Use an example or descriptive phrase to identify the corresponding stored value.
sql_template:
SELECT COUNT(T1.account_id)
FROM loan AS T1
INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND T1.amount < 200000;
